# Positive-correlation knowledge-based target.

This is a version of
[`targetG()`](https://github.com/vguillemot/SHIP/reference/targetG.md)
that estimates the common correlation from positive linked correlations
only. Negative linked correlations contribute zero to the off-diagonal
target. \$\$T\_{ij} = \bar{r}\_+\sqrt{s\_{ii}s\_{jj}}\$\$ for linked
pairs with positive correlation, where \\\bar{r}\_+\\ is their mean
positive correlation.

## Usage

``` r
targetGpos(x, genegroups)
```

## Arguments

- x:

  A \\n \times p\\ data matrix.

- genegroups:

  A list of genes obtained using the database KEGG, where each entry
  itself is a list of pathway names this genes belongs to. If a gene
  does not belong to any gene functional group, the entry is NA.

## Value

A \\p \times p\\ matrix.

## See also

Other covariance targets:
[`targetCor()`](https://github.com/vguillemot/SHIP/reference/targetCor.md),
[`targetD()`](https://github.com/vguillemot/SHIP/reference/targetD.md),
[`targetF()`](https://github.com/vguillemot/SHIP/reference/targetF.md),
[`targetG()`](https://github.com/vguillemot/SHIP/reference/targetG.md),
[`targetGstar()`](https://github.com/vguillemot/SHIP/reference/targetGstar.md)

## Author

Monika Jelizarow and Vincent Guillemot

## Examples

``` r
# require(SHIP)
data(expl)
target_matrix <- targetGpos(expl$x, expl$genegroups)
which(target_matrix[upper.tri(target_matrix)] != 0) # not many non zero coefficients !
```
